description: An audit log of account events with actor initials, action icons, and IP addresses.

import { KeyRoundIcon, LogInIcon, MailIcon, UserPlusIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" const events = [ { actor: "Rina Sato", action: "Signed in", icon: LogInIcon, ip: "203.0.113.24", time: "10:42", }, { actor: "Rina Sato", action: "Changed billing email", icon: MailIcon, ip: "203.0.113.24", time: "10:45", }, { actor: "Owen Hart", action: "Invited 3 members", icon: UserPlusIcon, ip: "198.51.100.7", time: "11:03", }, { actor: "Owen Hart", action: "Deleted API key", icon: KeyRoundIcon, ip: "198.51.100.7", time: "11:20", }, ] export default function AuditLogTable() { return (
Actor Event IP address Time {events.map((event, i) => ( {event.actor .split(" ") .map((n) => n[0]) .join("")} {event.actor} {event.action} {event.ip} {event.time} ))}
) }
